lead_raw_text:
The structure of Y2Ga2Zn2O8 (reduced formula YGaZnO4) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group P4/mmm (No. 123), with 14 atoms in the unit cell distributed over 8 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Ga and Zn each in tetrahedral environments with four O neighbors, while Y adopts an octahedral environment with six O neighbors. Corner-sharing is observed between Ga tetrahedra and Y octahedra, between Zn tetrahedra and Y octahedra, and between Ga and Zn tetrahedra, and the geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
